gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-zalando-sans-exp: Blocky, bold, unmistakably digital. Pixelify Sans cuts every line to a single depth, while Zalando Sans Expanded spreads out below it in a plain sans, its c tips never drifting toward each other.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-zalando-sans-sem: Chunky and playful, like a game screen. Pixelify Sans holds its line weight steady, and Zalando Sans SemiExpanded brings open-mouthed curves that make the pair's strongest quality its easy, wide-eyed legibility.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-zilla-slab: Sturdy, technical, a bit stubborn: Pixelify Sans lays down identical bar thickness across each line, with Zilla Slab beneath it opening every bowl-ended curve wide. They share a workmanlike spirit.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-encode-sans-semi: Loose, hand-drawn charm up top. Shantell Sans has a wide, canned-lid mouth and a fixed nib width, then Encode Sans Semi Condensed settles in below with an open s, quick and easy going.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-finlandica: Shantell Sans writes with one fixed nib width and a mouth wide as a cut tin lid, and Finlandica follows in a plain sans, e crossbars gaping. The two feel friendly.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-google-sans: Google Sans reads smooth, with no thick-thin shift and terminals pulled well back. And Shantell Sans, with its wide tin-lid mouth and fixed nib, adds the scrawl that keeps a paragraph lively.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-google-sans-flex: Scrawled and friendly, with a mouth wide as a cut tin lid. Shantell Sans keeps one nib width throughout, while Google Sans Flex ends each curve in a clean gap, tidy and crisp.
